content: Paulusor uwore Oihudi okkol loi ham goribar bár
Hetolla ãi Paulose Allar hãse munazatot ãṛu felai, tũwara zara Oihudi hitaralla ãi ehon Mosi Isar bondi oiyi.
Tũwara fuinno ze Allaye hibar rahamotor bebosta, tũwarare zanaibar bár ãr uwore diye.
Hibar he gufonplan ohir duwara ãre zanaiye, zendilla ãi age baṛit leikki.
Ar tũwara hin forile buzi fariba ze Mosir babute gufonplan buzibar kemota ãttu ase.
He gufonplan ehon zendilla gori Pak Ruhur duwara hibar pak asab edde nobi okkolor hãse forhaš oiye, agor zugor manušor hãse he bafe zanai diya no o.
Ei gufonplan oilde endilla ze, kušir hóboror duwara Oihudi okkol o Israili okkolor fũwati mirazdar, ekkui gar hissa, ar Isa Mosir butore asede wadar ekkui borator bági.
Allaye hibar ḍõr šoktir gune ãre ze rahamot dan goijje, hiyanor zoriya ãi kušir hóbor toboligor gulam bonilam.
Zodi o ãi paki manuš okkol beggunottuwaro šoṛo, ei rahamot ãre diya oiye, Oihudi okkolor hãse Mosir šima sara dónor hota tobolig gora oibolla,
edde he gufon planor ereda ki hin o zene hitarar sarme forhaš gori, hinor bar o ãr uwore diya oiye, zin hár kissu sirišti goroya Allaye etokkal dori gufon gori rakkil.
Hibaye hendilla goijjil zene Mosir zomator butottu di asmanor hár šašongoroya edde ruhi kemotar odihari okkolor hãse ḍoilla boḍoilla Allar giyan forhaš o.
Iyan aššilde hibar sirohalor issa, ar he issa hibaye ãrar Malik Isa Mosit furon goijje.
Ãra hibar loi šorik oiyore hibar uwore biššašor duwara himmot edde fura boroša loi Allar sarme ai fari.
Hetolla ãi tũwarare foriyad gorir, tũwaralla buli ze hár duk hošto ãi bordaš gori hinot tũwara niraš no oiyo, hin to tũwarar fohorai.
Ifišiyo okkololla Paulusor duwa
Hetolla ãi he Bafor sarme munazatot ãṛu felair,
ze asman zobinor hokkol zandar, beggun zinore fuwain howa ḍake.
Ãi duwa gori Allaye zene hibar ošeš mohimattu tũwarare šokti de, zene Pak Ruhor duwara tũwarar dil mojbut o.
Toi zene biššašor zoriya Mosiye tũwarar dilot bošoti gore. Ãi duwa gori, tũwara zene Mosir muhabbote murot lami šiyõr gasai tiyo.
Hár paki manušor fũwati Mosir muhabbot hoddur fatari lamba edde usol mur hin buzi faribolla šokti fo,
edde ze giyan furafuri buzibar baire, ãi duwa gori, ei muhabbot zene sino. Ar ei bafe zene Allar hár furaiyaye tũwara furon o.
Ãrar dilot ze šoktiye ham gore he šokti mozin hibaye ãrar hár ajju edde sintattuwaro beša beši ham gori fare.
Isa Mosir duwara edde zomator duwara hár bongšor bade bongšoye abadul abad Allar tarif gorok! Amen.
